description: A coordinator needs to match animals to foster homes based on medical needs, behavior, household restrictions, transport timing, and existing foster capacity without losing track of special constraints.

user_profile.persona: 34-year-old foster coordinator balancing urgent placements with volunteer limitations
user_profile.context: Potential foster homes exist, but each one has limits that only fit certain animals well
user_profile.communication_style: Constraint-aware and empathetic, wants animal needs and foster limits aligned clearly

fact_sheet.fact: A 3-year-old German Shepherd named 'Zeus' (ID: A4581) has severe separation anxiety and cannot be left alone for more than 3 hours.
Zeus requires 100mg of Trazodone, administered orally twice daily at 8 AM and 7 PM to manage his anxiety.
A 7-year-old Siamese cat named 'Luna' (ID: C1234) is diabetic and requires a quiet environment without young children.
Luna needs 2 units of Lantus insulin administered via subcutaneous injection twice daily, 15 minutes after her meals.
A 2-year-old Terrier mix named 'Rocky' (ID: A6789) is leash-reactive towards other dogs and must be the only canine in his foster home.
The Chen family (Foster ID: FH-012) at 123 Maple Lane has two children under the age of 10 and cannot foster animals with a known bite history.
John Miller (Foster ID: FH-025) at 456 Oak Ave, Apt 3B, is an experienced medical foster who is approved to administer injections and manage complex medication schedules.
John Miller's apartment building has a strict 40-pound weight limit for dogs.
Sarah Davis (Foster ID: FH-031) has two resident adult cats and can only foster felines that have tested negative for FeLV/FIV.
All foster placements must be recorded in the 'ShelterLuv' software platform, accessible at https://pawsitivecare.shelterluv.com.
The foster coordinator, Maya Patel, can be reached at m.patel@pawsitivecare.org or extension 102.
Transport volunteer Tom Jenkins is available for animal pickups and drop-offs on Mondays and Fridays between 10 AM and 4 PM.
Transport requests for Tom Jenkins must be submitted through the #transport-requests Slack channel at least 48 hours in advance.
The primary veterinary partner is Crestwood Animal Hospital, located at 789 Pine Street.
Routine vet appointments for foster animals are scheduled by Maya on Tuesdays and Thursdays only.
A 'Foster Go-Kit' containing 7 days of food, a collar, a leash, and initial medication is provided for every new placement.
The shelter's maximum active foster home capacity is currently set at 60 homes.
As of November 15, 2023, there are 54 active foster homes, leaving a capacity for 6 new placements.
A litter of four 3-week-old kittens (ID: C9901-C9904) requires bottle-feeding with KMR formula every 4 hours, around the clock.
The Chen family (FH-012) has a fully fenced backyard with a 6-foot wooden fence, making it suitable for high-energy dogs.
The after-hours emergency vet contact is Northwood Emergency Pet Clinic at 555-0199; fosters must call Maya Patel before going.
Weekly foster check-in reports must be submitted by foster parents via a Google Form by Sunday at 8:00 PM.
Luna's blood glucose levels must be monitored once a week using the shelter-provided AlphaTRAK 2 meter.
'Rocky' (ID: A6789) passed his basic obedience evaluation on October 30, 2023, but failed the dog-to-dog interaction component.
Behavioral support for foster homes is provided by our on-staff trainer, David Lee, via scheduled Zoom consultations.
The next foster orientation for newly approved volunteers is on December 2, 2023, at 11:00 AM at the main shelter building.
Sarah Davis (FH-031) lives in a third-floor apartment with no elevator, which is unsuitable for large dogs or dogs with mobility issues.
The standard quarantine period for any animal showing signs of URI (Upper Respiratory Infection) is 14 days in an isolated room.
A 10-year-old Beagle named 'Sadie' (ID: A3344) has advanced arthritis and needs a home with no stairs.
Sadie (ID: A3344) is prescribed 75mg of Carprofen once daily with food for her arthritis pain.
